notes.title: Rhythm Hotel Update Log: Ver 0.3.2-beta
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve received feedback that some players were unable to launch the game. [/p][p]After investigation, we’ve identified the cause and fixed the bug. [/p][p]The update is now live. Many thanks to everyone who reported the problem! 🙏[/p][p][/p][p]🛠 Patch Notes:[/p][p]1. Fixed a crash caused by the delayed initialization order of the multi-language manager[/p][p]2. Added function to switch social media interface automatically based on system language[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your continuous support and feedback. [/p][p]Have fun with the rhythm![/p]

notes.title: Rhythm Hotel Update Log: Ver1.3.3.3-beta
notes.notes: [p]Dear Rhythm Hotel Travelers,[/p][p]Recent refinements based on valuable feedback from our Rhythm Hotel Travelers. We have completed a meticulous polishing round. Below are the detailed improvements in this maintenance update:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]1.「All Rooms」:Fixed incorrect initiation points of rhythm waves[/p][p]2.「New Oath of the Peach Garden」:Resolved garbled text for error prompts.[/p][p]3.「All Rooms」:Adjusted failure notification text overflow[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Updates will roll out on a rolling basis. We’re accelerating the inn’s construction to open for business soon! Stay connected with us via our [url="https://discord.gg/ENet75YjE7"]Discord![/url][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Version Released！
notes.notes: [p]Dear Rhythm Hotel Travelers[/p][p]Our hotel is still under construction. To collect your valuable feedback and further refine the game, we’ve opened 3 levels in the Playtest version! Simply request, and you’ll receive playtest access.[/p][olist][*][p]Philosophy on Donkey-kicking[/p][/*][*][p]New Oath of the Peach Garden[/p][/*][*][p]Scientific Snapshots[/p][/*][/olist][p]Before our game release, we’ll regularly review your feedback and incorporate it into future updates. Maintenance and upgrades will occur periodically.[/p][p]Our team is working tirelessly to accelerate progress and open Rhythm Hostel’s doors to travelers worldwide as soon as possible![/p][p]Your input is essential! Keep sharing your experiences and ideas through our [url="https://discord.com/invite/ENet75YjE7"]Discord community[/url].[/p]
